notPinned.why: The IBS reference rates of 2029 to 2032 are set by a Senate resolution not yet published; the IBS side of a blended document is shown with stated hypothetical rates in a test and never published.
The Simples ICMS credit (CSOSN 101) depends on the issuer's revenue over the last 12 months and its LC 123 annex bracket, which Fiscal does not hold; CSOSN 102 is modelled.
